semantic_preflight.economic_sequence: prior strong or leader-like stock -> impulsive run-up -> peak -> main collapse or liquidation -> meaningful collapse-defining strict-gap layers -> persistent unresolved overhead zone -> material move below zone -> distinct lower trading regime and settling -> later first approach from below -> first upward return to the lowest meaningful unresolved collapse layer -> zone traversal or repair outcome
semantic_preflight.causal_background: collapse-induced price discontinuity in a previously strong stock
semantic_preflight.event_formation_time: meaningful collapse gap-zone formation during the main collapse leg
semantic_preflight.confirmation_trigger: first later upward return to the lower boundary of the lowest meaningful unresolved collapse-defining layer
semantic_preflight.entry_time: first completed one-minute bar with close at or above the relevant lowest-layer lower boundary, followed by the next legal one-minute open
possible_semantic_ambiguities: first lower-boundary touch versus confirmed close inside
same-day target fill under A-share T+1

chosen_time_anchors.executable_confirmation: first completed one-minute close at or above the lowest meaningful layer lower boundary
chosen_time_anchors.execution: next legal one-minute open strictly after confirmation
chosen_time_anchors.primary_target: upper boundary of the same frozen lowest meaningful layer

primary_zone_object.primary_layer_id: frozen V3 target_primitive_id: lowest meaningful unresolved collapse-defining layer
primary_zone_object.width: W = U-L and W must be strictly positive

event_and_execution.zone_acceptance_bar: first completed one-minute bar at or after FIRST_LOWER_RETURN_TIME whose close is at or above L; no upper cap is imposed because an acceptance bar may itself traverse the layer
event_and_execution.entry: first subsequent legal one-minute open strictly after the acceptance bar; legal requires a registered complete market minute, positive finite open, valid daily PIT/action lineage, trade_status=1, current_day_data_tradable, market_rule_valid, and open below the registered upper limit
event_and_execution.jumped_through_primary_layer: entry comparable-coordinate price strictly greater than U; exclude from executable return population and retain structurally

session_clock.within_h_sessions: from the anchor through the close of the h-th subsequent valid trading session; same-session is separately reported
session_clock.fixed_terminal_horizon: close of the h-th subsequent valid trading session after executable entry session
session_clock.t1_open: first legal open on the first subsequent valid trading session after entry session
session_clock.intraday_path_start: strictly after executable entry timestamp for executable outcomes
session_clock.right_censoring: metric-specific fail closed when the required subsequent valid session or minute path is unavailable by 2021-12-31

structural_outcomes.full_fill: future comparable-coordinate high at or above U
structural_outcomes.max_traversal: (maximum future comparable-coordinate high-L)/(U-L), raw and clipped to [0,1]
structural_outcomes.terminal_traversal: (terminal comparable-coordinate close-L)/(U-L), raw and clipped to [0,1]
multi_layer_progression: number of meaningful layers reached by 20 sessions

failure_outcomes.fast_rejection: first completed one-minute close strictly below L after executable entry and before primary-layer full fill
failure_outcomes.daily_rejection: first completed daily close strictly below L after executable entry and before primary-layer full fill

executable_outcomes.mfe: maximum strictly post-entry comparable-coordinate high divided by entry comparable-coordinate price minus one
executable_outcomes.mae: minimum strictly post-entry comparable-coordinate low divided by entry comparable-coordinate price minus one

weighting_and_concentration.date_equal_method: aggregate event outcomes within re-entry date, then equally weight dates
formation_date: top five dates contribution to successful full fills
reentry_date: top five dates contribution to positive T5 net return
top five dates contribution to full fills

verdict_rule_frozen_before_outcomes.structural_traversal_supported: event-weighted full-fill by 10 sessions is at least 50 percent and re-entry-date-equal full-fill by 10 sessions is at least 45 percent
verdict_rule_frozen_before_outcomes.executable_return_supported: at least one of T5-close or T10-close has strictly positive mean net return under both event weighting and re-entry-date-equal weighting
verdict_rule_frozen_before_outcomes.year_stability_supported: the supported executable horizon has positive annual mean net return in at least four of eight Development years
verdict_rule_frozen_before_outcomes.episode_clustered: top five re-entry dates contribute more than 50 percent of successful 20-session full fills or more than 50 percent of positive T5 net-return mass
verdict_rule_frozen_before_outcomes.edge: structural, executable, and year-stability support all pass and episode clustering does not
verdict_rule_frozen_before_outcomes.not_monetizable: structural support passes but executable-return support fails
verdict_rule_frozen_before_outcomes.clustered: otherwise favorable structural or executable evidence meets the episode-clustered condition
verdict_rule_frozen_before_outcomes.weak_or_unstable: some structural or executable evidence exists but the edge rule fails for breadth or chronology
verdict_rule_frozen_before_outcomes.no_effect: neither structural traversal nor executable-return support passes
verdict_rule_frozen_before_outcomes.interpretation: discovery classification only; none of these gates is a strategy parameter
